## What We Do

Tag Team Printing is a screen printing and custom apparel shop in Cornwall, Ontario. We print custom t-shirts, hoodies, crewnecks, long sleeves, tank tops, and headwear for businesses, organizations, schools, events, and individuals across Eastern Ontario and Canada-wide.

We specialize in:
- Custom screen printing (single colour to multi-colour)
- Bulk and volume apparel orders with competitive pricing
- School spirit wear and event shirts
- Staff uniforms and corporate apparel
- Band and artist merchandise
- Direct-to-film (DTF) transfers

We source garments through S&S Activewear, giving us access to hundreds of blank apparel styles from brands like Gildan, Bella+Canvas, Next Level, AS Colour, and more.

## Service Area

Cornwall, Ontario is our home base. We serve clients locally (in-person pickup available), across Eastern Ontario, and ship Canada-wide.

## Connection to Drop Dead Thread

Tag Team Printing is the commercial printing arm associated with Drop Dead Thread (dropdeadthread.ca), a Cornwall-based art and apparel brand run by Stacey Case. DDT handles artistic and indie releases; Tag Team Printing handles production and wholesale printing orders.

## Why Choose Us

- One-week standard turnaround on most orders
- Transparent pricing — no hidden fees
- Local business, 12+ years of printing experience
- Order online or reach out directly for a custom quote
- S&S Activewear access for broad garment selection
